headline.purpose: Section titles, page H1s in Operate. Archivo.

title.purpose: Card titles, panel headers. Sora semibold.

label.purpose: Nav items, badges, table headers. Sora medium.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Rest state for cards needing a hint of depth.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on cards, stat cards.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action button — Till Orange fill, surface text, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c2410c; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9a3412; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(234,88,12,0.12); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent fill, ink text, hairline-hover border. Used for cancel/back actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #1c1917; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f5f5f4; border-color: #a8a29e; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(234,88,12,0.12); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: 1px hairline border, warm-paper-surface background, 8px radius, 3px Till Orange focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1c1917; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #c2410c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(234,88,12,0.12); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #716d68; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Warm-paper-surface background, 1px hairline border, 12px radius. Flat at rest, shadow-lg on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; transition: box-shadow 250ms ease, border-color 250ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); border-color: #c2410c; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #57534e; } .ds-card-value { margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #c2410c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar nav item — ghost button, 8px radius. Active: primary-subtle bg + Till Orange text + semibold. aria-current on active.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.38rem 0.55rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #57534e; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f5f5f4; color: #1c1917; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(234,88,12,0.08); color: #c2410c; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped filter chip. Inactive: hairline border, ink-secondary text. Active: Till Orange fill, surface text.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #57534e; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #c2410c; color: #c2410c; } .ds-chip--active { background: #c2410c; border-color: #c2410c; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview:
Gear&Glitch is the operating system for an electronics retail and repair business — and the visual world reflects that duality. The warm-black surfaces and orange tool accents evoke a well-organized workbench: functional, tactile, built for speed. The neutrals are warm stone, not cold gray, because a workshop is a warm place. The primary accent is Till Orange — the color of a tool handle, a safety signal, a sale-complete pulse — used sparingly so it never loses its force.

The system serves two modes: Operate (the POS till, the admin dashboard, the staff portal) and Persuade (the marketing site, the public storefront). Operate surfaces are dense, scannable, keyboard-first. Persuade surfaces are editorial, spacious, image-led. The same warm palette and tactile component language runs through both, so the brand reads as one product.

Dark mode is not a mechanical inversion of light — it is a composed warm-black world with a brighter Till Orange that maintains contrast on dark. Both themes are designed explicitly, not flipped.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals (stone family, not slate) in both themes
Till Orange as the single primary accent — rare, purposeful, never decorative
Archivo display + Sora body — industrial grotesque paired with a humanist sans
Tactile, confident components — hairline borders, solid fills, clear focus rings
4px-base spacing scale with deliberate tight/generous rhythm
Semantic colors kept consistent across themes

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Till Orange is used on ≤10% of any given screen. If everything is orange, nothing is.

rules.name: The No-Gray Rule
rules.body: Neutral text is always warm-tinted (stone family), never generic gray. A workshop has warm light, not fluorescent.

rules.name: The Money Rule
rules.body: Monetary values use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits don't jitter as values change.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus). No shadow on a resting card.

rules.name: The Tactile Rule
rules.body: Buttons feel confident — solid fills on primary, hairline borders on secondary, clear focus rings on all. No ghost borders that vanish on dark themes.

dos: Do use Till Orange on ≤10% of any screen — its rarity is its force.
Do use warm stone neutrals, never generic gray, in both themes.
Do use tabular-nums on all monetary values so digits don't jitter.
Do keep touch targets ≥32px on Operate surfaces, ≥44px on customer-facing surfaces.
Do pair Archivo for display/headlines with Sora for body — never swap them.
Do design dark mode as a composed warm-black world, not a mechanical inversion.
donts: Don't use Till Orange for decoration — it's the primary action color, not a background tint.
Don't use slate or cool-gray neutrals — the workshop is warm.
Don't add shadows to resting cards — depth is a response to state.
Don't use emoji as icons — draw SVGs with one stroke and one weight.
Don't animate every section entrance — one authored moment per page, reduced-motion safe.
Don't use Sora for display headlines — that's Archivo's role; Sora is the body voice.
